basic_details.job_title: Anna University Resident Counsellor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Anna University, Chennai, through its International Hostels, has invited applications for the appointment of Resident Counsellor for Boys (Flora) and Girls (Tulip). Only male and female full-time research scholars (unmarried) in the Main Campus can apply. Applications in the prescribed format must be addressed to The Executive Warden, International Hostels, Anna University, Chennai - 25, and must be received by 17 November 2026, 5.00 pm.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the pay, the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Resident Counsellor for Boys (Flora) and Resident Counsellor for Girls (Tulip)
Full Time Research Scholar (Unmarried) in Main Campus
Application in the prescribed format addressed to the Executive Warden

content_sections.heading: About Anna University International Hostels
content_sections.text: The International Hostels belong to Anna University, Chennai - 600 025, and include the Flora hostel for boys and the Tulip hostel for girls. The circular is issued by the Warden-IH & Dean, CEG, and a copy has been sent to the Director, RCC, for upload on the Anna University website.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be addressed to: The Executive Warden, International Hostels, Anna University, Chennai - 25. Use the prescribed application format attached to the circular (the second page of the notice). Send the application with a covering letter forwarded by your Guide and the Head of the Department. The application must be received by 17 November 2026, 5.00 pm. The notice does not mention a particular postal mode or what to write on the envelope. The application format asks for: name, date of birth, marital status, religion, nationality, languages known, education qualification, date of registration (with the Ph.D. Provisional Registration Order copy), Ph.D. registration number, department, name of the guide, residential address, mobile number and e-mail ID, with the date and signature. A recent passport size photo must be affixed in the box on the form.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The circular covers two Resident Counsellor appointments in the International Hostels: Resident Counsellor for Boys (Flora) – for the Flora (Boys) hostel. Resident Counsellor for Girls (Tulip) – for the Tulip (Girls) hostel. Eligibility as printed in the circular: Applicants must be Full Time Research Scholars in the Main Campus of Anna University. Applications are invited from male and female scholars. Applicants must be unmarried. The application form asks for the Ph.D. registration number and date of registration, with a copy of the Ph.D. Provisional Registration Order. Terms of appointment: selected scholars will initially be appointed for one year, and their service will be extended based on their performance. The pay or honorarium for the post is not specified in the notice. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Anna University Resident Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 17 November 2026, 5.00 pm.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for Resident Counsellor in Anna University International Hostels?
faq.answer: Male and female Full Time Research Scholars (Unmarried) in the Main Campus of Anna University can apply.

faq.question: Q3. Can married research scholars apply?
faq.answer: The circular invites applications only from unmarried full-time research scholars.

faq.question: Q4. Which hostels are the Resident Counsellor posts for?
faq.answer: One post is Resident Counsellor for Boys in the Flora hostel and the other is Resident Counsellor for Girls in the Tulip hostel, both in the International Hostels.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Anna University Resident Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format, with a covering letter forwarded by your Guide and the Head of the Department, addressed to The Executive Warden, International Hostels, Anna University, Chennai - 25.

faq.question: Q6. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Enclose a copy of the Ph.D. Provisional Registration Order and the covering letter forwarded by your Guide and Head of the Department, and affix a recent passport size photo on the form.

faq.question: Q7. For how long is the Resident Counsellor appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for one year, and the service will be extended based on performance.
